title_cyr: Ај што оган гори во планина
title_latin: Aj što ogan gori vo planina
title_en: Hey, a fire burns in the mountain
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Partisan (WWII) song, apparently traditional or folk-style; no author known to me. 'Мi викна' is rendered as 'called out to me' (my reading).

lines.cyr: Ај што оган гори во планина,
lines.lat: Aj što ogan gori vo planina,
lines.en: Hey, a fire burns in the mountain,
hey, in the mountain, in the middle of the woods.

lines.cyr: Ај што пушки грмат, бомби трештат,
lines.lat: Aj što puški grmat, bombi treštat,

lines.en: hey, they shake the whole land.

lines.cyr: смела борба водат, не се жалат,
lines.lat: smela borba vodat, ne se žalat,
lines.en: they fight boldly, they do not complain,

lines.cyr: на фашисти клети не се предаваат.
lines.lat: na fašisti kleti ne se predavaat.
lines.en: they do not surrender to the damned fascists.
A partisan woman called out to me boldly:
Here is the land of Macedonia,
for you fascists a black grave.
